title: Etsy's biggest update in years!
key_points: Etsy's new CEO is Kruti Patel, who shared updates during Q1 2024 investors call
Etsy GMS (gross merchandise sales) showed slight increase for the first time in nearly two years
App-based checkouts increased from 43% in December to 47% last quarter
Etsy is shifting search away from only prioritizing what's most likely to convert toward more personalized relevance-based machine learning
Etsy stated search and discovery changes help surface higher quality, more differentiated inventory
Valentine's Day, Easter personalization, birthdays, and weddings were called out as strong Q1 sales areas
Birthdays were the largest and fastest-growing gift segment in Q1
Etsy specifically said buyers come to Etsy not only for what they buy, but for who they buy it from
Etsy is testing ways to make seller identity, craftsmanship, process, and maker stories more visible
Etsy wants to reduce friction in listing process through AI-powered listing tools and more automated workflows
Previous Etsy AI title tool caused many sellers to tank their best-selling listings, with Etsy failing to warn about potential negative impact
For Q2, Etsy expects marketplace GMS growth of 3% to 5% year-over-year
For full year, Etsy expects low single-digit marketplace GMS growth
Starla Moore notes these growth estimates are high in her personal opinion

summary:
This video covers Etsy's Q1 investors call where new CEO Kruti Patel shared platform updates. The presenter is Starla Moore, founder of Handmade Alpha Academy for Etsy sellers and manager at eRank.com, which she describes as Etsy's most popular SEO tool.

The video reports that Etsy GMS (gross merchandise sales - money sellers make versus Etsy's own profits) showed a slight increase for the first time in nearly two years, attributed to better marketing and increased app usage. App-based checkouts rose from 43% in December to 47% last quarter, meaning sellers should check how their storefronts display on the Etsy app since it now represents nearly half of customers.

Regarding search and SEO, Etsy stated they're shifting away from only prioritizing what's most likely to convert toward more personalized relevance-based machine learning. They said search and discovery changes help surface higher quality, more differentiated inventory, which Moore notes gives shops in saturated industries improved chances of being seen rather than first pages being occupied only by high-ranking mega sellers.

For Q1 sales performance, Etsy called out Valentine's Day, Easter personalization, birthdays, and weddings as strong areas, with birthdays being the largest and fastest-growing gift segment. Etsy specifically stated that buyers come not only for what they buy but for who they buy it from, and they're testing ways to make seller identity, craftsmanship, process, and maker stories more visible - something Moore notes sellers have requested for nearly 6 years.

On AI tools, Etsy mentioned wanting to reduce friction through AI-powered listing tools and automated workflows. Moore expresses caution, referencing a previous incident where Etsy's AI title tool caused many sellers to tank their best-selling listings because Etsy didn't warn about potential negative impacts of changing best sellers.

For projections, Etsy expects Q2 marketplace GMS growth of 3% to 5% year-over-year and low single-digit growth for the full year. Moore personally considers these estimates high, noting that Amazon and eBay are seeing nearly identical traffic dips, and that higher gas prices and increased cost of living are impacting discretionary spending. She expresses optimism about Kruti Patel compared to previous CEO Josh Silverman, stating the current goal should be showing shoppers that sellers are humans and differentiating from sites like Temu.
